title: Download negative keywords
content_data:
Use this endpoint to download the list of negative keywords for Search Ads. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/download/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | object_type {Required} | string | Object type. Use this field to specify whether you want to download the list of negative keywords for a campaign or ad group.

Enum values:
  • `CAMPAIGN`: campaign.
  • `ADGROUP`: ad group.
| | object_id {Required} | string | Object ID. Use this field to pass in a campaign ID or ad group ID that you want to download the list of negative keywords for.

Specify this field according to `object_type`:
  • If `object_type` is `CAMPAIGN`, assign to this field a campaign ID.
  • If `object_type` is `ADGROUP`, assign to this field an ad group ID.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search_ad/negative_keyword/download/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&object_type=CAMPAIGN&object_id={{object_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response If the download is successfully completed, the xlsx file stream will be returned, and you can see three columns entitled ``, ``, and `` in the returned file. If the API call fails, the below parameters will be returned. ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| ```
